name: Uno
title: Uno Score Sheet – Free Printable PDF & Scorekeeper
description: Free printable Uno score sheet for playing to 500 points, with a card values chart, in three PDF versions, plus an online scorekeeper.

columns: Card left in an opponent's hand

content.intro: Print an Uno score sheet for playing to 500, or keep score on your phone. The card values are on this page, and the sheet tells you who got there first.
howToUse: Write each player's name at the top of a column. When someone plays their last card, they win the hand and score points for every card still held by the other players.

Count the cards left in everyone else's hands: face value for number cards, 20 for each Draw Two, Reverse and Skip, and 50 for each Wild and Wild Draw Four. Write the total in the winner's column for that hand and leave the other boxes empty or write 0.
The first player to reach 500 points wins the game. Online, the sheet adds every hand and shows the winner as soon as someone passes 500.

howToPlay.heading: How a hand of Uno works
paragraphs: Each player is dealt seven cards, and the top card of the draw pile is turned over to start the discard pile. On your turn you play one card that matches the top of the discard pile by colour, number or symbol, or a Wild card, which lets you choose the colour. If you cannot play, or choose not to, you draw one card and may play it straight away if it fits.

Action cards change the flow of the game. A Skip makes the next player miss a turn, a Reverse changes direction, and a Draw Two makes the next player draw two cards and lose their turn. A Wild Draw Four does the same with four cards, and is only allowed when you hold no card of the current colour.

When you are down to one card, say Uno before the next player starts their turn. The hand ends as soon as someone plays their last card, and then the counting starts. Because only the winner scores, a hand where the others are caught holding Wilds can be worth more than several small wins.

tips: If the last card played is a Draw Two or Wild Draw Four, the next player picks up those cards before counting, so they add to the winner's score.
Write the total in the winner's column only. Leaving the other boxes empty keeps the totals honest: they show points won, not cards held.
For lowest-score Uno, each player writes the value of their own cards every hand, and when someone passes 500 the lowest total wins. Play it on the paper sheet.
Stacking a Draw Two on a Draw Two is a house rule, not part of the official rules. It makes hands swing harder but doesn't change how cards are counted.

faqs.a: The player who goes out first scores points for the cards left in the other players' hands: face value for number cards, 20 for Draw Two, Reverse and Skip cards, and 50 for Wild and Wild Draw Four cards.

faqs.q: How many points do you need to win Uno?
faqs.a: 500. The first player to reach 500 points across several hands wins the game.

faqs.q: Do the other players score anything in Uno?
faqs.a: Not in the standard rules: only the hand's winner scores. In a common alternative, everyone writes down the value of their own cards each hand, a player is out at 500 and the lowest total wins.

faqs.q: What happens if you forget to say Uno?
faqs.a: If another player catches you with one card before the next player starts their turn, you draw two cards. It does not change the scoring.

faqs.q: How much is a Wild Draw Four worth?
faqs.a: 50 points to the player who goes out, the same as a plain Wild card.

faqs.q: How many people can play Uno?
faqs.a: Two to ten players. The printable sheet has six columns and the online scorekeeper takes up to ten.
